name: chaos.social
discord_description: chaos.social – a Fediverse instance for & by the Chaos community
candidate_notes: ~6,100 monthly active users. Registration currently closed except by invite link from an existing member ('ask your friends for one'), so it's not self-service signup for strangers.

name: Cyberplace.social
discord_description: Cybersecurity, fandom, video games, technology, dog photos and most importantly, you.
candidate_notes: ~758 monthly active users. Registration open, no approval or reason required, 18+ minimum age. Rules explicitly forbid posting breach data or joining mainly to promote red-team tooling.

name: Fosstodon
discord_description:
Fosstodon is an invite only Mastodon instance that is open to those who are interested in technology; particularly free & open source software.

If you wish to join, contact us for an invite.
candidate_notes: ~7,266 monthly active users. Invite-only: open registration is disabled, you need an existing member to invite you, so it is not a durable self-service signup.

name: social.circl.lu
discord_description: The Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg (CIRCL) is a government-driven initiative designed to gather, review, report and respond to computer security threats and incidents.
candidate_notes: Only ~15 monthly active users - small and CERT-staff oriented. Registration open but requires approval and a stated reason.

name: Hackers.Town
candidate_notes: ~139 monthly active users. Registration currently closed; only accepts referrals vouched for by existing members, so not a durable public self-service join path right now - included for reference but treat as low-priority to list.

name: Kali Linux Forums
discord_description: Official Offensive Security forum for Kali Linux help, tool discussion, and development.
candidate_notes: Direct fetch returned 403 (bot protection) but this is the long-standing, widely-referenced official Kali forum.
